title: Operating system hardening: unnecessary services, accounts and features

videos.script: A server is installed to do one job. Over the years it starts doing others. {{scan}} This is the client portal of a small accounting firm, scanned from the desk next to it. The job needs two ports. Eight answer. {{ports}} Every one of them is a program a stranger can talk to without logging in. Some send passwords in clear text. One answers anybody who says the word public. {{accounts}} Then the accounts. A second root under another name. An intern who left, with a password and full sudo. {{ssh}} And SSH, letting root log in with a password. {{lab}} First you build the lab this course runs on, seven machines on your own computer. Then you take the portal apart. Measure, change, and measure again. {{after}} By the end the same scan finds two ports, and you can say why each one is there.
